04/14.03.2024 Heard Mr. Sabyasanchi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Manoj Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Garhwa P.S. Case No.280/2023,
registered for the alleged offence under Section 498A, 341, 323/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the husband of the informant and he is working in the State of Gujarat and the allegations are made that from Gujarat, he has instigated the mother-in-law of the informant on telephone to demand dowry and if it is not being fulfilled to beat the informant.
He further submits that the petitioner will cooperate in the investigation.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer on the ground that the petitioner is the husband and he does not deserve anticipatory bail.
5. It appears that the petitioner is the husband and at the time of alleged incident, he was in Gujarat and that has already been indicated in the contents of the FIR itself.

In the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the above-named petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender,
he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa in connection with Garhwa P.S. Case No. 280/2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Ajay/
